answer.reason: The verses tell of one event for Azariah, the Spirit coming on him and his message to Asa, which goes beyond the bare summary.

clauses.english: was moved by the Spirit of God to meet Asa and urge him and Judah to seek the LORD
clauses.quote: The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you

doubts: The dataset cites 1CH 15:1-2, which concerns David and the ark, not Azariah; those verses were left out.
2CH 15:8 names Oded the prophet, not Azariah, so it was not used.
